title: Customer-scoped auditlog retention milestones and onboarding checklist
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers require per-customer audit log retention controls (retention TTLs, export, and legal hold) as part of onboarding and SOC2/ISO evidence. Current platform has global retention and no customer-scoped TTLs, which blocks regulated customers and makes audits inconsistent.

Goal: Define and deliver a milestone-driven plan to enable per-customer auditlog retention policies, including: config surface in Console, ingestion/housekeeping changes in runtime, export hooks for long-term archival, KMS/entropy considerations, and an onboarding checklist that ties to SOC2 evidence buckets. The plan should minimize risk to existing tenants, provide rollback choreography, and surface clear metrics and audits for reviewers.
acceptance_criteria: Console exposes a per-customer audit log retention setting up to 7 years with sensible defaults and UI copy reviewed by Legal
Runtime components apply retention TTLs at ingestion and during periodic compaction without causing increased tail latency above current SLOs
Export path implemented (s3/secure-archive) with configurable schedule and proof-of-transfer logs available for auditors
Onboarding checklist created and integrated into enterprise-sales playbook: risk review, KMS key provisioning, legal hold flow, and verification steps
Canary onboarding executed with two pilot customers and documented results: throughput, costs, and any observed data-access regressions
Rollback plan documented and tested in staging, including metric thresholds that trigger global rollback
Security review completed and signed-off by InfoSec; penetration test scope updated to include retention controls
comments: 2025-02-14 - Aisha Raman: Kickoff meeting notes: aligned PM, Eng, Legal, and InfoSec on priority. Agreed to break work into three milestones: (1) policy model + console UX, (2) runtime enforcement + export, (3) onboarding + evidence workflows.

2025-02-21 - Miguel Ortega: Engineering spike scheduled with Runtime team to measure compaction cost for customer-scoped TTL. ENG-1842 owner assigned to prototype. Blocker: unclear KMS key model for per-customer exports — Legal/CloudInfra to advise.
2025-02-27 - Legal (Claire Huang): Provided draft legal-hold language and data-retention display requirements for contracts. Requires audit trail of policy changes (who changed retention and when).

2025-03-01 - Runtime lead (Sanjay Patel): Spike results: per-customer TTLs add ~5% compaction work in worst-case batch; recommendation to implement incremental compaction windowing and backpressure to keep tail latency stable. Engineering estimate updated to 8 points.

2025-03-03 - Design (Rita Gomez): Console mockups v1 uploaded. Two variants: inline policy in Customer Settings vs dedicated Audit Logs tab. Prefer dedicated tab for discoverability. Need copy review from Compliance team.

2025-03-04 - PM (Aisha): Customer pilot target candidates: Acme Health (requires 7-year retention), FinEdge (requires legal hold). Reached out to SEs to schedule pilot onboarding in April. Action: finalize export encryption model by 2025-03-12.
